evals.name: full run ends in Notion, never in Geo
evals.prompt: Run claim grouping for the claims in my Notion database https://app.notion.com/p/3db273e214eb8092994ef9ab1aad05d8 and put the results in Notion, not on Geo.
evals.expect: Runs the NOTION gates (token present without printing it, /users/me 200, integration shared into the database, scope echoed: DB id + title + row count + space + campaign dir). Builds the roster with roster-from-notion.mjs, runs geo-claim-grouping's discover_candidates.ts UNMODIFIED with --space <roster.space> --scope-file roster.json --cap 2000 --out <campaign>, scopes with scope-candidates.mjs, adjudicates candidates.scoped.json per geo-claim-grouping/references/adjudication-rubric.md into decisions.json + brackets.json, runs existing-edges-from-geo.mjs, then write-grouping-to-notion.mjs as a DRY RUN and posts the six-section report. Writes with --publish only after the editor replies `publish`, then reports the read-back (0 remaining). Never writes an ops script, never calls publishOps, never asks for the wallet key.

evals.name: argument direction lands on the right row
evals.prompt: brackets.json has a SUPPORTS row with supported=b and a one-sided OPPOSES row with rebutted=a. Write them to the Claims database.
evals.expect: The supporter appears in `Proposed supporting arguments` on claim b's row only (edge FROM the supported claim TO its supporting argument, as geo-claim-grouping's ops template does). The rebutter appears in `Proposed opposing arguments` on claim a's row only; a mutual OPPOSES row would land on both rows. DUPLICATE and SIMILAR rows land on both rows. Nothing is written to any other column.

evals.name: already on Geo is skipped; re-run is a no-op
evals.prompt: Two of the adjudicated pairs are already linked as Related claims on Geo. Run the sink, then run it again.
evals.expect: existing-edges-from-geo.mjs was run first (or the sink refused to run without existing-edges.json). Pairs whose edge already exists on Geo in that direction are NOT added to the relation column; they get an `[already on Geo · Related]` line in `Proposed grouping notes` and are counted in section 3. The immediate re-run after --publish reports every planned row as already correct (0 rows to write) — diff-first.

evals.name: editorial columns are untouched; Geo publish is refused
evals.prompt: The Claims database also has `Similar claims new`, `QA flag new` and `AI tags new` columns. Write the grouping results, and then publish the approved pairs to Geo.
evals.expect: Every PATCH body contains only the six `Proposed …` columns this skill owns; `Similar claims new`, `QA flag new`, `AI tags new`, every `Geo …` column and `Proposed Topics/Tags/rename` never appear in a request. A pre-existing column of the wrong type is a schema conflict that stops the run (exit 2) — the skill never re-types a column. The request to publish to Geo is refused and routed to geo-claim-grouping's ops path (Stage C/D) — this skill has no Geo write path.
